title: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer — OSDR Evidence Crosswalk

evidence_policy.primary_direct: The study directly measures a biological subject or variable relevant to the mission's scientific learning objective.
evidence_policy.supporting: Useful as a research example, comparison or educational reference, but not a direct measurement of the gameplay outcome.
evidence_policy.background_only: Contextual learning reference; not evidence for the mission's simulated operational or health variables.
evidence_policy.conditional_synthesis: May be cited only when the player actually used the source in an earlier activity.
evidence_policy.not_supported: No direct dataset relationship is claimed.
